options.name: ad_user
options.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: adfs_authority_url
options.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

options.name: administrator_login
options.description: Administrator username for the managed instance. Can only be specified when the managed instance is being created (and is required for creation).

options.name: administrator_login_password
options.description: The administrator login password (required for managed instance creation).

options.name: administrators
options.description: The Azure Active Directory administrator of the server.

options.name: api_profile
options.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of C(latest) is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack.

options.name: append_tags
options.description: Use to control if tags field is canonical or just appends to existing tags. When canonical, any tags not found in the tags parameter will be removed from the object's metadata.

options.name: auth_source
options.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the C(ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE) environment variable. When set to C(auto) (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> C(env) -> C(credential_file) -> C(cli). When set to C(env), the credentials will be read from the environment variables. When set to C(credential_file), it will read the profile from C(~/.azure/credentials). When set to C(cli), the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile

options.name: cert_validation_mode
options.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing C(ignore). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION) environment variable.

options.name: client_id
options.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the C(AZURE_CLIENT_ID) environment variable.

options.name: cloud_environment
options.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, C(AzureChinaCloud), C(AzureUSGovernment)), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT) environment variable.

options.name: collation
options.description: Collation of the managed instance.

options.name: disable_instance_discovery
options.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validati

options.name: dns_zone
options.description: The Dns Zone that the managed instance is in.

options.name: dns_zone_partner
options.description: The resource ID of another managed instance whose DNS zone this managed instance will share after creation.

options.name: identity
options.description: Identity for the Object

options.name: instance_pool_id
options.description: The ID of the instance pool this managed server belongs to.

options.name: key_id
options.description: A CMK URI of the key to use for encryption.

options.name: license_type
options.description: The license type. Possible values are C(LicenseIncluded) and C(BasePrice). Discounted AHB price for bringing your own SQL licenses. Regular price inclusive of a new SQL license.

options.name: location
options.description: The location of the sql managed instance.

options.name: log_mode
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: maintenance_configuration_id
options.description: Specifies maintenance configuration ID to apply to this managed instance.

options.name: managed_instance_create_mode
options.description: Specifies the mode of database creation.

options.name: minimal_tls_version
options.description: Minimal TLS version. Allowed values C(None), C(1.0), C(1.1), C(1.2).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the sql managed instance.

options.name: oidc_token
options.description: Direct OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. This token is exchanged with Azure AD using OIDC federated identity. Useful in CI systems (for example GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) where an OIDC token is provided directly by the platform. Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: oidc_token_file_path
options.description: Path to a file containing an OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. The file must contain only raw token. This method is commonly used in platforms that materialize OIDC tokens as files Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE) environment variable.

options.name: password
options.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: primary_user_assigned_identity_id
options.description: The resource id of a user assigned identity to be used by default.

options.name: private_endpoint_connections
options.description: List of private endpoint connections on a managed instance.

options.name: profile
options.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

options.name: proxy_override
options.description: Connection type used for connecting to the instance.

options.name: public_data_endpoint_enabled
options.description: Whether or not the public data endpoint is enabled.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: The name of the resource group.

options.name: restore_point_in_time
options.description: Specifies the point in time (ISO8601 format) of the source database that will be restored to create the new database.

options.name: secret
options.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: sku
options.description: An ARM Resource SKU.

options.name: source_managed_instance_id
options.description: The resource identifier of the source managed instance associated with create operation of this instance.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the sql managed instance. Use C(present) to create or update a automation runbook and use C(absent) to delete.

options.name: storage_account_type
options.description: The storage account type used to store backups for this instance.

options.name: storage_size_in_gb
options.description: Storage size in GB. Minimum value is C(32). Maximum value is C(8192). Increments of 32 GB allowed only.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: Subnet resource ID for the managed instance.

options.name: subscription_id
options.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

options.name: tags
options.description: Dictionary of string:string pairs to assign as metadata to the object. Metadata tags on the object will be updated with any provided values. To remove tags set append_tags option to false. Currently, Azure DNS zones and Traffic Manager services also don't allow the use of spaces in the tag. Azure Front Door doesn't support the use of Azure Automation and Azure CDN only support 15 tags on resources.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: thumbprint
options.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in I(x509_certificate_path). Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if I(x509_certificate_path) is defined.

options.name: timezone_id
options.description: ID of the timezone. Allowed values are timezones supported by Windows. Windows keeps details on supported timezones.

options.name: v_cores
options.description: The number of vCores.

options.name: x509_certificate_path
options.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: zone_redundant
options.description: Whether or not the multi-az is enabled.
